items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Bennie Carter played with that band and the trombone player that was with Jimmy Lunsford played with that band, too, played third trombone with Jimmy Lunsford.

ctx.x: Horace Henderson had a good band in Wilberforce, and Rex Stewart was in that band down there. Bennie Carter played with that band and the trombone player that was with Jimmy Lunsford played with that band, too, played third trombone with Jimmy Lunsford.
Was he Jonah's cousin? Isn't that -- ?
